description: Connect vapor and liquid superficial velocities, phase drift and radial redistribution to measured local void fraction. Density calculations are disclosed fixed physical preprocessing.
limitations: Drift-flux family; local radial profile is a separate phenomenological correction
Source radial coordinate is normalized by the maximum sampled coordinate, not a certified tube radius
Densities are fixed pressure-derived IAPWS approximations; no target-fitted fluid property
Whole source runs held out; same apparatus and some shared acquisition days
No phase slip; a deliberately simpler competing explanation
title: Vapor transport and radial phase distribution
